name: Urban Demons
source: Urban Demons, a tale of two souls lost in the darkness. Take control of Peter, the perverted young male, as you journey around the city seeking to complete your goals. Encounter a variety of women, all of whom you can talk and interact with… or more! However, discover your fate as you travel into the very depths of hell to uncover the truth of who you are. But more importantly who or what you will become. Your main goal is to corrupt all the women you can find as you travel between the real world and the Otherworld. This goal becomes slightly easier when you are blessed by demonic forces. But are these powers there to merely help you? Or are there more sinister motives at hand? With a large selection of NPCs to interact with and a compelling story that will see you enter the depths of hell, be sure to check out the latest version!​
translation: 《城市恶魔》，一个关于两个灵魂迷失在黑暗中的故事。控制彼得，一个变态的年轻男性，在城市中旅行，寻求完成你的目标。遇到各种各样的女性，你可以与她们交谈并互动……甚至更多！然而，当你深入地狱深处，揭开你是谁的真相时，你就会发现自己的命运。但更重要的是你将成为谁或什么。你的主要目标是腐化你在现实世界和异界之间旅行时能找到的所有女性。当你受到恶魔力量的祝福时，这个目标会变得稍微容易一些。但这些力量只是为了帮助你吗？还是还有更险恶的动机？有大量可供互动的NPC以及引人入胜的故事，让你进入地狱深处，请务必查看最新版本！​
